versions.content: Asynchronous certificate operation handling For all asyn- chronous Csm or KeyM operations, the Dcm shall wait until the callback has been called, indicating a successful job termination. If the result (e.g. KeyM_ResultType) is E_OK, the Dcm shall continue to process the 0x29 request, if the result is different to E_OK, the Dcm shall skip the further processing and return a negative response with NRC 'GeneralReject'.
